I declared `export { freshSource as fresh }` AFTER its definition but the function parameter is named `seed`?? Wait — look at the definition: I wrote `async function freshSource(...)` but with a parameter list shadowing? The original `fresh` had parameters (api, link, name, ctx) — I renamed the function but left signature; calls still say `fresh(...)`. The export alias is `export { freshSource as fresh }` — but you can't export a name as itself... `export { freshSource as fresh }` exports freshSource UNDER the name fresh — that means local calls to `fresh` don't resolve; the local name is freshSource. Rename function to `fresh` locally and export it: `export async function fresh(...)`. Fix: change definition name to `fresh` and remove the alias.
